description:
Accounts Assistant

Location: Cambridge
Contract: Full-Time, 12-Month Fixed-Term Contract

We are looking for an organised and detail-oriented Accounts Assistant to join our client's finance team on a 12-month fixed-term contract. Finance Operations

- Supporting month-end and year-end activities
- Maintaining financial records and documentation

About You

To be successful in this role, you'll have:
- Previous experience in an Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant, or similar role
- Strong purchase ledger and sales ledger knowledge
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- Good organisational and time management skills
- Strong communication and relationship-building abilities
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office
- Experience using finance or ERP systems

Desirable
- Knowledge of VAT principles
- Experience supporting audits
- Exposure to multi-currency or international finance operations
- Studying towards, or interested in studying, AAT or a similar accounting qualification

What's On Offer?
- Competitive Salary
- A supportive and collaborative team environment
- Hybrid working arrangements
- Onsite Parking
- Opportunity to develop your finance and accounting skills
- Valuable experience within a complex and fast-paced organisation

description:
Italian speaking Credit Controller
- Location: Cambridge - Hybrid (1 day per week in the office, 4 days remote)
- Salary: £35,000-£38,000 + excellent benefits
- Languages: Fluent Italian and English - essential
- Working Pattern: Hybrid

The Opportunity

Our client is a world-leading international organisation with successful operations across multiple global markets. As part of its growing international finance team, the company is looking for an experienced Italian speaking Credit Controller to manage accounts receivable activities across its Italian customer base.

The Role

As an Italian speaking Credit Controller, you will support the end-to-end accounts receivable process for business customers in Italy. You will take responsibility for managing customer accounts, collecting outstanding debt, monitoring credit exposure and resolving account queries, while working closely with sales, customer service and wider finance teams.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage a portfolio of Italian business customer accounts and proactively pursue outstanding payments
- Contact customers regarding overdue balances and negotiate appropriate payment arrangements.
- Monitor customer credit status and make recommendations regarding credit limits and credit blocks.
- Post and accurately allocate incoming customer payments and cash receipts.
- Issue customer statements, payment reminders and dunning correspondence.
- Investigate and resolve account queries, disputes and payment discrepancies.
- Work closely with customers to resolve issues and maintain positive commercial relationships.
- Review customer-held orders and identify potential credit-related issues.
- Provide information and support for internal and external audit requirements.
- Maintain accurate customer account records and ensure financial data is kept up to date.

Candidate profile
- Fluent Italian and English - essential
- Previous experience in Credit Control, Accounts Receivable or a similar finance role.
- Experience managing customer accounts and collecting outstanding debt.
- Strong customer relationship and communication skills.
- Experience working with SAP or another ERP system would be advantageous.
- Experience with electronic invoicing would be beneficial.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
- The ability to investigate and resolve account queries and disputes effectively.
- Excellent organisation and time-management skills.
- The ability to manage your own workload and prioritise competing deadlines.
- Resilience and confidence working towards financial KPIs and collection targets.
- A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively with sales, customer service and finance colleagues.

Salary & Benefits

£35,000-£38,000 + excellent benefits, including:
- Private medical insurance
- Pension
- Leisure travel insurance
- Compassion and care time off
- Volunteer time off
- Hybrid working - 4 days working remotely and 1 day in the Cambridge office
- A range of additional employee benefits and wellbeing initiatives

The role also offers an excellent level of flexibility, with four days working from home each week and just one day required in the Cambridge office.

How to Apply

If you're an experienced Credit Controller or Accounts Receivable professional who is fluent in Italian and English and looking for an international role with excellent hybrid flexibility, we'd love to hear from you.

Please send your CV to:

Jonathan Grimes

The Language Business

- Salary: £45,000 per annum (dependent on experience)
- Location: Office-based: St Neots - Cambourne area. Own transport required due to location.
- Travel: Occasional travel (Visiting Group company sites/events)
- Hours: 8.30am-5.00pm Monday-Thursday; 8.30am-4.00pm Friday

We're recruiting a hands-on Marketing Manager to join a well-established engineering, manufacturing business.

This is a great opportunity for a commercially minded, detail-focused marketer who enjoys creating content, running campaigns and working closely with technical teams.

Key Responsibilities:
- Manage and update Group websites content using a CMS (product/service pages, news, SEO, improvements)
- Plan, create and coordinate social media content (content calendars and scheduling)
- Build and deliver email marketing campaigns and workflows using HubSpot
- Create marketing collateral including case studies, brochures, product/service content and internal comms
- Own proofreading and quality control across all outbound marketing materials
- Track campaign performance and provide insights/recommendations for continuous improvement
- Organise UK and overseas exhibitions, including logistics, promotional materials and pre- and post-show activity
- Liaise with engineering/production stakeholders to maintain accurate content and consistent branding across Group companies.

Essential Skills & Experience:
- Support the planning and delivery of marketing campaigns across digital and print channels.
- Experience updating and managing websites via a CMS
- Social media content planning and coordination experience
- Confident using Canva (or similar tools) to produce marketing assets
- Excellent written communication skills with exceptional proofreading attention to detail
- Experience with photography and video content (creating content or managing suppliers)
- Able to work office-based in their main site located in the St. Neots - Cambourne area
- Full UK driving licence

Desirable:
- Proven marketing experience within engineering, manufacturing, production or a similar B2 B/industrial environment
- Hands-on HubSpot experience
- Video editing, photography and design skills, using tools such as Canva.
- Marketing qualification (CIM / degree / equivalent)

Benefits include:
- Annual bonus based on company & individual performance
- 20 days holiday + bank holidays (increasing to 26 with service + BHs)
- Life assurance, Sick pay scheme, Pension scheme
- Free on-site car parking

HRGO Recruitment offers permanent and temporary jobs across the UK. You must have current UK right to work to be considered. We aim to respond to all applications. HRGO is an equal opportunities employer.

title: PR manager
description:
PR manager

Location: Contracted to our Peterborough office with the flexibility for hybrid working

Salary: £36,000 - £40,000 depending on experience

Hours: Full time, 37.5 hours per week

Contract: Permanent

Benefits: We want all our employees to feel valued and engaged and are committed to offering a positive working culture along with a good work-life balance. As well as ensuring we pay our employees fairly, we offer the following benefits: Flexible working, Generous annual leave, Private Medical Insurance, including dental and optical, Pension Scheme, Sick Pay, Death in Service, Employee Assistance Programme, Bike Loan Scheme, Cycle 2 Work Scheme, Eyecare, Discount Portal.

Be a part of an energetic and vibrant team who are driven by the desire to improve the lives of people living with kidney disease. Our vision is the day when everyone lives free from kidney disease.

Kidney disease affects one in ten people in the UK, yet it still doesn't get the attention it deserves. At Kidney Research UK we are determined to change that. We're looking for an experienced PR manager to help us significantly grow our media reach and make kidney disease impossible to ignore.

The Role
- Lead our press office and storytelling function, shaping and delivering coverage that raises the profile of the charity
- Show the reality, urgency and impact of kidney disease on patients and their families
- Act as the first point of contact in the press office, spotting news stories and building lasting relationships with journalists
- Oversee our people and fundraising communications function
- Ensure patient and supporter stories are handled with care and the right consent, with safeguarding and data processes in place
- Develop integrated plans with our fundraising teams, telling inspiring stories that encourage people to get involved
- Work closely with fundraising, policy, research and marketing and communications colleagues to ensure PR plays a central role in our strategic priorities and campaigns

What We're Looking For
- A strong track record in press or media relations
- Excellent writing skills
- The judgement to operate confidently and at pace
- Ability to spot a news story
- The credibility to build and maintain relationships with journalists
- Experience handling sensitive stories, consent, safeguarding and data processes with care
- Ability to collaborate across teams and build buy-in for PR within strategic priorities
- Passion for making a difference to people living with kidney disease

About Kidney Research UK:

Kidney Research UK is the leading charity in the UK focused on funding research into the prevention, treatment and management of kidney disease. Our vision is the day when everyone lives free from kidney disease and for more than 60 years the research, we fund has been making an impact. But kidney disease is increasing as are the factors contributing to it, such as diabetes, cardiovascular disease and obesity, making our work more essential than ever.

At Kidney Research UK we work with clinicians and scientists across the UK, funding and facilitating research into all areas of kidney disease. We collaborate with partners across the public, private and third sectors to prevent kidney disease and drive innovation to transform treatments.

Over the last ten years we have invested more than £71 million into research. We lobby governments and decision makers to change policy and practice to ensure that the estimated 7.2 million people living with all stages of kidney disease in the UK have access to the most effective care and treatment, and to make kidney disease a priority.

Most importantly, we also work closely with patients, ensuring their voice is heard and is at the centre of everything we do, from deciding which research to invest in to how we plan our priorities and our work across the charity. Those patient contributions are vital, always helping us and our partners to understand what life is like with kidney disease, always ensuring we see the patient behind the treatment and always reminding us that behind every statistic and every number is a person - the patients and the carers who inspire our mission and push us forward to make a difference and change the future of kidney disease.

How to Apply

If you're ready to make kidney disease impossible to ignore, we'd love to hear from you. Please complete the online application form and submit together with your CV. Closing date: Sunday 22 November 2026.

Interviews will be held in our Peterborough office on Thursday 3 December 2026.

We are committed to providing equal opportunities for everyone and encourage applications from all sections of the community.

No agencies please.

You may have experience in the following: PR Manager, Press Officer, Media Relations Manager, Head of Press, Senior Press Officer, Public Relations Manager, Communications Manager, Media Manager, Case Study Manager, Storytelling, Charity Communications Manager, Charity PR, Charities, Third Sector, Not for Profit, NFP, etc.

title: Sales Ledger Assistant
description:
We're recruiting a Sales Ledger Assistant to join a growing business based in St Ives. This is an excellent opportunity to join a busy and supportive finance team, taking responsibility for invoicing activities across a portfolio of clients.This role has become available due to a departure from the team, and within this role, you will report into the Finance Manager. This role is being recruited as both temporary and permanent as the organisation need a short notice start.

As the incoming Sales Ledger Assistant, you will be tasked with the following duties:
- Process sales invoices and credit notes, maintaining accurate sales ledger records.
- Set up new clients and maintain customer information across internal systems.
- Respond to customer queries and liaise with internal teams to resolve issues.
- Support month-end billing activities and work towards monthly targets.
- Review invoices for discrepancies and provide general administrative support across the team.

As the successful applicant, you will have strong organisational skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while working to deadlines. You will be confident communicating with both customers and colleagues and be comfortable working with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel. Previous sales ledger or finance administration experience would be beneficial; however, this role could also suit an entry-level candidate looking to start a career in finance, provided they can demonstrate a positive attitude, willingness to learn, and strong administrative skills.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a well-established and growing organisation that can offer long-term development and valuable experience within a finance environment. For more information, apply now or contact Jamie at Pure for an initial discussion.

title: Senior Communications Officer
company: East Cambridgeshire District Council - Agency - Permanent
description:
Are you a creative communicator ready to celebrate local government achievements? East Cambridgeshire District Council has an exciting Senior Communications Officer opportunity!

Location: Ely, Cambridgeshire, CB7 4 EE

Salary: £34,811 to £39,481 per annum

Job Type: Full time, 12 months fixed term contract

Hours: Hybrid working, with attendance at council offices three days per week

Closing Date: Sunday 25 October 2026

About Us:

East Cambridgeshire District Council is a local government organisation serving residents across the region. We are committed to delivering high-quality, customer-focused services and have recently achieved silver accreditation from the Investors in the Environment scheme, ranking 43rd nationally on the council climate scorecard. We prioritise environmental sustainability and responsible operations while supporting our communities.

Senior Communications Officer - The Role:

You will work as part of a busy, collaborative communications team to deliver clear, consistent and engaging communications to residents, employees, councillors and stakeholders. Your primary focus will be promoting the council's achievements, demonstrating the positive impact of its services and showing how the council improves local people's lives. You will manage multiple projects, create compelling content and build positive relationships across council services and external partners.

Senior Communications Officer - Key Responsibilities:
- Produce clear, accurate and engaging content for websites, newsletters, social media, briefing notes and press releases
- Develop and deliver communications and engagement plans that promote the council's priorities, services and achievements
- Create case studies, success stories and community outcomes for use across media and digital channels
- Manage and monitor social media channels, creating engaging content and responding to enquiries
- Create and maintain website content that is accurate, accessible and user-focused
- Support internal communications activities to keep employees informed about council priorities and organisational change
- Build effective relationships with colleagues, partners and media to gather information and promote council achievements
- Monitor media coverage and social media activity, identifying opportunities and reputational risks
- Evaluate campaign effectiveness and report on performance metrics
- Participate in the 24/7 communications on-call rota and work outside normal hours when necessary

Senior Communications Officer - You:
- Excellent communicator with strong written and verbal communication skills
- Highly organised with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines
- Experienced in developing and delivering communications campaigns and engagement activities
- Skilled in creating engaging content across digital and traditional channels
- Confident in managing corporate social media platforms and online communities
- Passionate about storytelling and showcasing positive outcomes for residents and communities
- Collaborative team player equally confident working independently and using your own initiative

Benefits:
- The opportunity to help communicate and celebrate the council's achievements and contribution to local communities as local government transitions to new unitary authorities
- Potential to contribute to a major local government transformation programme
- Flexible and hybrid working arrangements
- Membership of the Local Government Pension Scheme
- Generous annual leave entitlement
- Learning and development opportunities
- A supportive and experienced communications team

Closing date for completed applications: Sunday 25 October 2026

The selection process will be: Wednesday 4 and Thursday 5 November 2026

To submit your CV for this exciting Senior Communications Officer opportunity, click Apply today!
